import pandas as pd

# Load source data
source_path_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_53/training_0.csv"
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_path_0, index_col=0)

# Perform the transformation as per operation history:
# group_by = [Source1_53_0.continent]
# aggregations = [avg(Source1_53_0.beer_servings), avg(Source1_53_0.spirit_servings), avg(Source1_53_0.wine_servings), avg(Source1_53_0.total_litres_of_pure_alcohol)]

# Group by 'continent' and calculate the average of the specified columns
result = df0.groupby('continent', as_index=False).agg({
    'beer_servings': 'mean',
    'spirit_servings': 'mean',
    'wine_servings': 'mean',
    'total_litres_of_pure_alcohol': 'mean'
})

# Ensure the column types match the target schema
result = result.astype({
    'continent': 'string',
    'beer_servings': 'float',
    'spirit_servings': 'float',
    'wine_servings': 'float',
    'total_litres_of_pure_alcohol': 'float'
})

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_53/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
